args: Is the December 31 correction one single batch event, or genuinely independent per merchant?

Did the 407 stock_movements kind='adjustment' events in 2025 all fire at the exact same timestamp (suggesting one system/data event), or do different merchants' corrections have distinct timestamps (consistent with independent, organic annual stocktakes)?
